svg.title: Designing the schedule scan for an AI that can be wrong
svg.desc: A phone screen titled 'Review scanned shifts' from ShiftSwap's schedule scan, with five numbered callouts. 1, set expectations: a note at the top says 'Check before saving. It can misread handwriting.' 2, show the evidence: each of five shift rows shows a cropped image of the handwritten paper schedule next to the value the model read. 3, draft, not action: the list is labeled 'Draft, 5 shifts found, none saved', every value has an edit pencil, and the Friday row, where the handwriting says 7 to 10 but the model read 1:00 to 10:00 PM, is outlined and marked 'Check this'. 4, easy to dismiss and undo: a Discard draft link, and after saving a '5 shifts saved' message with an Undo button for ten seconds. 5, a person confirms costly actions: nothing saves until the student taps 'Save 5 shifts', and the model never posts, trades, or approves a shift.
svg.text: Says up front that it can
Each shift sits beside the part
of the photo it was read from
taps Save. The model never posts,
